items.lede: A North Carolina musician was sentenced to 18 months in prison for collecting more than $10 million in royalties from Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, and YouTube Music in a massive streaming royalty fraud scheme. [...]
items.title: Musician sent to prison for $10 million streaming fraud using AI bots

items.lede: Man gets 18 months for AI scheme stealing $8M in music streaming royalties.
items.title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift

items.lede: The first-ever criminal case involving AI-assisted music streaming fraud has concluded, with an American citizen facing 18 months behind bars and an $8M fine.
items.title: American jailed for commanding 10,000 bots to stream his own AI-generated songs
